mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) signals weakening residential investment, reducing construction and materials sector earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the civilian labor force (PAYEMS) signals rising labor supply without corresponding demand growth, increasing unemployment and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising labor force participation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, reducing earnings for industrial firms and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of falling industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals easing inflationary pressures, reducing the likelihood of aggressive Fed tightening and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of falling CPI (t-test p > 0.05).
